missions.briefing: Mara's receipt printer grew into a mess. Split it: line_total(qty, cents) and money(cents). Print the receipt exactly; cents are whole numbers, so $11.98 is 1198.
missions.starter:
# Mission 12: Receipt Refactor
# One line per item: "<qty> x <cents>: $<money>"
# Then: "TOTAL: $<money>"
# Example: 1 250 -> 1 x 250: $2.50 / TOTAL: $2.50
import sys

def line_total(qty, cents):
    return qty + cents  # BUG: should multiply

def money(cents):
    return "$" + str(cents)  # BUG: cents -> dollars.cents

rows = [line.split() for line in sys.stdin.read().strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]
total = 0
for r in rows:
    qty, cents = int(r[0]), int(r[1])
    sub = line_total(qty, cents)
    total += sub
    print(f"{qty} x {cents}: {money(sub)}")
print(f"TOTAL: {money(total)}")

tests.name: handles five cents and free items

missions.title: Receipt Refactor

missions.briefing: A reading went out of order in a log. Print the index of the first value smaller than the one before it, or -1 if the sequence never drops. Shrink the failure to the smallest input.
missions.starter:
# Mission 21: Find the Smallest Reproducer
# Print the INDEX of the first drop, or -1. (This reports the value.)
import sys

nums = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
bad = -1
for i in range(1, len(nums)):
    if nums[i] < nums[i - 1]:
        bad = nums[i]  # BUG: prints the value, not the index
print(bad)
